en.title: Minimum Deletions to Sort a Word
en.description: Given a word consisting only of lowercase English letters, find the minimum number of letters to delete so that the remaining letters, in their original relative order, form a lexicographically non-decreasing string. The remaining letters do not have to be contiguous, and equal letters may all be kept.
en.input: One line containing a non-empty string S. 1≤|S|≤100000, and S contains only a-z.
en.output: Output the minimum number of letters to delete.
en.explanation: The kept part must be a non-decreasing subsequence of the original string. The minimum number of deletions equals |S| minus the length of the longest non-decreasing subsequence.
hints: Compute the longest non-decreasing subsequence character by character; use upper_bound when handling equal characters.
